Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the NHM Chandigarh Peer Educator/Supporter recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue with all necessary documents as per the reporting time mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Peer Educator/Supporter post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Any Graduate from a recognized university with basic computer skills and proficiency in English and Hindi. Preference will be given to those with a history of viral hepatitis treatment or relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Peer Educator/Supporter position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Peer Educator/Supporter post is 35 years as of the application deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the NHM Chandigarh Peer Educator/Supporter posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to ensure they have all required original documents and their self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the NHM Chandigarh office. Specific details regarding the venue and reporting time are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position under the National Health Mission Chandigarh. The job type is contractual.
